title: Fictional bridge inspiration source catalog for SAGE-EvoBridge
research_question: Which sourced fictional bridge forms can broaden the beam and truss inspiration library while keeping observations separate from unverified design ideas?
acceptance_criteria: Catalog primary sources from games, film and animation with Vietnamese observations and proposed abstractions clearly separated.
Record page reading and image/video inspection limits, unknown dimensions/materials and rights status; no fictional mechanics become engineering evidence.
Publish the single reviewed source catalog additively in the authorized existing Obsidian vault and verify identical SHA256; preserve existing accepted artifacts.
safety_notes: User requests research only and explicitly adds game, film and animation bridge forms; no invention implementation or model training.
Claim ceiling IDEA; G0 applies to provenance and scope only, all engineering validation remains NOT_APPLICABLE for this literature collection.
Original planner write_scope is unchanged; one Markdown document holds catalog, selection method and limits.
No progress-saving automation is created or re-enabled.
review_notes: Independent separate same-platform Codex reviewer; not the author and not a cross-provider review. Approval covers the bounded fictional-bridge source catalog and its additive Obsidian publication only. Independently checked primary-page statements, all 8 record identities, old vault preservation, and matching source/destination/handoff hashes.
